spectra-covariates-real: p.5 'What is real and what is not': the author states the scope of what is real, in his own release. The value is attributed and does not assert the data is real beyond his statement.

spectra-target-real-column: p.5: the schema lists target_real as the original operational label, untouched. The author defines his own column.

spectra-target-not-real-findings: p.6: 'Results on target must never be quoted as findings about real churn behavior'. A limit the author states on use of his own release. The text after it is garbled by OCR and the value does not rely on it.
spectra-construction-withheld: p.6: construction details, generating parameters and answer key are retained privately; the full specification can be shared with reviewers on request. The author states what he withholds. Clipped words ('retaine') do not change the sense.
spectra-complete-bar-defined: p.6 'What we would like people to do with them': the author names the five-part complete bar and asks for all of it, on identical splits with paired confidence bounds on held-out rows. He defines the bar he asks for. The value states a request, not a result.
